observation: The async predicate returns a truthy Promise immediately; fulfillment adopts its false resolution without repolling. Recorded postLoginWorker was still installing with active/controller null, despite workerReadyAt being set. Navigation then happened before activation; clientsClaim is not assumed and controller remained null.
fix_requirement: Use a bounded host loop awaiting page.evaluate snapshots, or a bounded page.evaluate Promise loop, and explicitly assert an activated worker snapshot before navigating; do not use an async waitForFunction predicate.
